errors.what: The locking disc cutout sits on the side opposite the drive pin. In a real Geneva drive the relief is centred on the pin direction. That lets the wheel tip clear the disc during indexing, while the full disc arc faces the wheel to lock it during dwell. Here, at dwell (driver 172.92 and 202.92) the cutout faces the wheel, so the wheel is not locked. At engagement (t=0.00, 0.44, 4.36) the full disc body overlaps the wheel.
